thread:
rebecca: URGENT: APAC POC for CoralNet stuck. Dedicated pool create in ap-northeast1 shows 'pending' for >30m and allocation calls are returning 429 + NoAvailableCapacity. Customer on a tight window.

miguel: ping @sophie @dani. Can you paste the pool id and the error lines from the allocation service? Also did sales request a committed reservation or burst?

rebecca: pool id: pool-coral-01
Errors copied from agent logs:
```
2026-03-28T02:14:07Z ERROR allocation_service: NoAvailableCapacity region=ap-northeast1 pool=pool-coral-01 gpus=8
2026-03-28T02:14:08Z ERROR quota: reservation_label_check failed expected=commit_apac got=commit_us-west
2026-03-28T02:14:09Z ERROR http: 429 allocation_service rate_limit exceeded
```

sophie: That reservation_label_check hints sales selected the wrong SKU or region on the purchase order. I can repro via rictl.

dani: Running quick inspect: `rictl reservations list --project=coralnet-poc` shows reserved-apt-200 -> location=us-west1. So mismatch confirmed.

rebecca: Oof, customer explicitly requested Tokyo due to latency. Is cross-region rebind possible or do we need a new reservation?

miguel: We can't rebinding an active committed reservation to a different region; will need a new reservation in ap-northeast1. For today the fastest path is an hourly-burst pool in APAC (no commit).

priya: Two operational caveats: (1) provider-level quotas can still block burst pools even if our allocation service is happy. Check GCP quota for GPUs in ap-northeast1. (2) 429s indicate our allocation service is being hammered; add 503/429-aware retries with jitter on the client side.

rebecca: Miguel / Sophie can you try creating an hourly pool now? If that works I'll update the customer and postpone committed reserve creation. Also they asked about KMS for keys & audit logs for Dedicated. Do we have a quick answer?

sophie: For Dedicated under our tenant we support customer-managed keys via GCP KMS only (for now). We can enable KMSEnable=true on the pool resource and forward audit logs to their SIEM. I'll attach a short KMS config snippet after I create the pool.

dani: Creating burst pool: command:
```
rictl pools create --project=coralnet-poc --region=ap-northeast1 --type=burst --gpus=8 --machine=a2-megagpu
```
Started at 02:23Z. Will post allocation logs.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-9901 "CoralNet POC: Dedicated pool provisioning pending in ap-northeast1" assigned eng-platform.

priya: While pool spins up, i'll check cloud provider GPU quota:
```
gcloud compute regions describe ap-northeast1 --project=redwood-cloud --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```
If quota is low we'll need a quota request with the CSP which can take hours.

miguel: Also double-check billing/reservation labels on the order record. Sales accidentally used the 'US-West committed' SKU code earlier. We should add a checklist item to the POC sales flow to confirm region SKU.

dani: Update 02:31Z: burst pool created pool-coral-01-burst status=active. Allocation logs:
```
2026-03-28T02:31:12Z INFO allocation: allocated 8 gpus pool=pool-coral-01-burst region=ap-northeast1 run=smoke-1
2026-03-28T02:31:15Z INFO runtime: container started image=redwood/runtime:1.9
```

rebecca: Great. I'll relay to the customer. Sophie please post KMS snippet so security can start the questionnaire answers.

sophie: KMS snippet (for Dedicated within our tenant):
```
kms_config:
  provider: GCP_KMS
  key_name: projects/<proj>/locations/global/keyRings/<kr>/cryptoKeys/<key>
  kms_enable: true
log_forwarding:
  enabled: true
  destination: syslog://siem.customer.example:514
```
I'll also note we cannot support external HSM for tenant-shared Dedicated right now; that is an option for Private (VPC) installs.

priya: Quick note on rate limits: engineering recommends small concurrency bump + retry policy client-side: initial_delay=300ms, max_delay=3s, max_retries=5, with full jitter. Should reduce 429 noise.

miguel: Sales action: update PO with APAC SKU OR approve burst followed by a short commit. Alex from commercial can price a 2-week commit pro-rata and an hourly rate for burst. @rebecca do you want me to loop Alex?

rebecca: Yes please loop Alex and ask for both numbers. Also attach the sec questionnaire to the ticket so we can track answers.

dani: Final status: burst pool operational, smoke run passed. Leaving dedicated commit creation on hold until pricing confirmed. Will keep INC-9901 open for provenance.

rebecca: Thanks team. I'll message customer and keep them on the burst pool. Re-open thread if the commit path is approved or if we hit provider quota.
